hook.text: Once you 'own' your paycheck, handing part of it to the government feels like theft.

buildup.text: Studies show people value what they own more than what they don't. A mug worth $5 feels like $9 once it's yours.

discovery.text: Pre-tax income feels like 'your money' even though you never actually received the full amount.

twist.text: Countries that show post-tax salary first—like some in Scandinavia—report less tax resentment.

climax.text: The endowment effect explains why tax cuts feel like gifts but tax increases feel like robbery.

punchline.text: You value it more because it feels like yours. That's the trap.

quiz.question: What is the endowment effect?
options: People overvalue things they already possess
People prefer public goods over private goods
